text:
alex: Pushed a small TF change that propagates IAM tags onto the GPU subnets so monitoring agents pick up env tags. Staging `terraform apply` failed with a taint error though. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3287 — can someone take a quick look? target canary window tomorrow 09:30 PT if we get approvals.

maria: I can review in ~30m. ping me here when it's ready.

chris: link gives 403 for me — is the PR private? alex: it's in the infra repo, you should have access. try again?

alex: fixed permissions, should work now. quick snippet from the plan that failed:

```
# aws_subnet.gpu[2] will be updated in-place
  ~ tags = {
      ~ "Name" = "gpu-subnet-3" -> "gpu-subnet-3"
      + "iam_env" = "prod"
    }

Error: ResourceInUse: cannot modify subnet when attachments exist
```

sam: seems like AWS doesn't like the in-place tag change when ENIs are attached. we've seen this before — need to detach/reattach or do a replace.

kalpana: We'd rather avoid replace for the whole subnet during a weekday canary. Two options: 1) add a lifecycle ignore_changes on `aws_subnet.tags` and apply a separate non-disruptive tagging job, or 2) schedule a short maintenance window to detach, apply, reattach (riskier).

maria: Agree with Kalpana. For canary tomorrow I'd prefer adding `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags] }` and doing tags via awscli/ansible job afterwards. Can you add a comment to the PR with the change?

alex: makes sense. I'll add the ignore_changes and a note to run a one-off tagging script after canary. putting up a tiny follow-up commit now.

chris: also, make sure to include a rollback plan in PR description: command to run to remove the lifecycle block and restore previous state if needed.

alex: good call — adding rollback steps (+ how to verify ENI attachments) in the PR body.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: staging apply failed for infra/staging at 2026-03-16T15:04:02Z — error ResourceInUse on aws_subnet.gpu[2]. See PR 3287 for fix proposals.

sam: quick note — @maria @chris can we get approvals after alex pushes the ignore_changes commit? I can be second approver if needed.

maria: yep, will review right after the commit lands. :+1:

chris: I'll take a look as well and approve if it matches the rollback checklist.

alex: Commit pushed: added lifecycle ignore_changes on tags and added a follow-up job script `scripts/tag-gpu-subnets.sh` with dry-run flag. PR updated.

maria: reviewing now. small nit: update the script docs to mention running with `--dry-run` first.

alex: done. documented.

maria: approved.

chris: approved.

sam: approved and queued for canary window 2026-03-17 09:30 PT. tagging job scheduled in maintenance playbook as non-disruptive run.

kalpana: thanks all. filing a short post-canary checklist so SRE can verify tag propagation and metrics for 1 hour after canary.

alex: thanks everyone — will monitor staging and post results here. :rocket:
